plan:
- Flight Controller (e.g., Pixhawk/ArduPilot), Electronic Speed Controllers (ESCs), Brushless DC motors, propellers, LiPo battery with Power Distribution Board (PDB).
- GPS module, Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU - accelerometer/gyroscope/magnetometer), barometer for navigation and stabilization.
- Carbon fiber or aluminum frame, landing gear, motor mounts, vibration dampeners, and associated fasteners.
- Telemetry radio, RC receiver/transmitter, optional camera module for FPV or data collection.
- Custom 3D-printed enclosures for sensitive electronics, battery tray, and unique sensor mounts.

subSteps.title: 3D print all custom mounts and enclosures
Clean and deburr all 3D printed parts, removing support material
Solder XT60 power connector and ESC power leads to the Power Distribution Board
Solder motor phase wires to the corresponding ESCs
Connect ESC signal wires to the Flight Controller's PWM/DShot outputs
Wire power (5V from PDB) and data (UART, I2C) from the Flight Controller to the GPS module
Wire power (5V from PDB) and data (UART) from the Flight Controller to the Telemetry Radio Module
Wire power (5V from PDB) and data (SBUS) from the RC Receiver to the Flight Controller
Wire power (5V from PDB) to the FPV Camera and wire its Video Out to the Video Transmitter's Video In
Wire power (12V from PDB) to the Video Transmitter and its SmartAudio/IRC Tramp to the Flight Controller
Perform initial power-on without propellers and verify PDB 5V/12V outputs
Connect Flight Controller to PC and flash latest stable firmware (e.g., ArduPilot)
Configure basic Flight Controller parameters, including ESC protocol and motor order/direction
Verify RC receiver input, GPS lock, and compass functionality in the Flight Controller software
Test motor spin direction and throttle response for each motor individually (props removed)
Verify FPV camera video output and Video Transmitter functionality
Calibrate IMU (accelerometer/gyro) and compass sensors
Attach frame arms and landing gear to the Frame Bottom Plate
Mount motor mounts and motors onto the frame arms, then attach ESC mounts and ESCs to the frame arms
Mount the Power Distribution Board onto the Frame Bottom Plate (if not integrated)
Install the Flight Controller into its enclosure and mount it to the Frame Top Plate with vibration dampeners
Mount GPS, Telemetry Radio, RC Receiver, Camera, and Video Transmitter modules to their respective mounts and attach to the Frame Top Plate
Route and secure all electrical wiring using zip ties or electrical tape for strain relief
Attach the Frame Top Plate to the Frame Bottom Plate using standoffs and screws
Mount the Battery Tray and the Package Delivery Mechanism to the frame, then install propellers

projectDescription: An autonomous delivery drone uses a flight controller, GPS, and multi-rotor propulsion to perform automated package transport. It integrates FPV for monitoring, a telemetry radio for communication, and a dedicated package delivery mechanism for secure drops.

imagePromptSnapshot.description:
Project idea: Automatic drone

Design notes: Automatic operation, Autonomous flight

Electrical components (current): Main Flight Controller (mcu, 38x38x12mm); 8x actuator: Front Left Motor, Front Right Motor, Rear Left Motor, Rear Right Motor +4 more; 2x power: Main LiPo Battery, Power Distribution Board; GPS Module with Compass (sensor, 35x35x10mm); 4x module: Telemetry Radio Module, RC Receiver, FPV Camera Module, Video Transmitter (VTX)

Mechanical/structural parts (current): 10x structural: Frame Top Plate, Frame Bottom Plate, Front Left Frame Arm, Front Right Frame Arm +6 more; 4x mechanism: Front Left Propeller, Front Right Propeller, Rear Left Propeller, Rear Right Propeller; 16x 3d_printed: Front Left Motor Mount, Front Right Motor Mount, Rear Left Motor Mount, Rear Right Motor Mount +12 more; 4x misc: Flight Controller Vibration Dampener Set, M3 Aluminum Standoffs, M3x6mm Screws, M3x10mm Screws

Assembly: Frame Top Plate → M3 Aluminum Standoffs (M3x6mm screws); M3 Aluminum Standoffs → Frame Bottom Plate (M3x6mm screws); Frame Bottom Plate → Front Left Frame Arm (M3x10mm screws); Frame Bottom Plate → Front Right Frame Arm (M3x10mm screws); Frame Bottom Plate → Rear Left Frame Arm (M3x10mm screws); Frame Bottom Plate → Rear Right Frame Arm (M3x10mm screws); Front Left Frame Arm → Front Left Motor Mount (M3x10mm screws); Front Right Frame Arm → Front Right Motor Mount (M3x10mm screws); Rear Left Frame Arm → Rear Left Motor Mount (M3x10mm screws); Rear Right Frame Arm → Rear Right Motor Mount (M3x10mm screws); Front Left Frame Arm → Front Left ESC Mount (M3x6mm screws); Front Right Frame Arm → Front Right ESC Mount (M3x6mm screws); Rear Left Frame Arm → Rear Left ESC Mount (M3x6mm screws); Rear Right Frame Arm → Rear Right ESC Mount (M3x6mm screws); Front Left Motor Mount → Front Left Propeller (propeller nut/washer) (+31 more connections)

assumptions: Basic electronics knowledge including polarity and voltage identification
Basic soldering experience for fine pitch components and power connections
Familiarity with drone flight controller firmware configuration (e.g., ArduPilot, Betaflight)
Ability to safely handle and discharge LiPo batteries
Access to a computer for firmware flashing and configuration
